description_for_human: Browse 3,000+ Web3 jobs, 500+ career guides, and 200+ glossary terms at Hashtag Web3.
description_for_model: Hashtag Web3 is a Web3 job board and career resource platform. Use it to search blockchain, crypto, DeFi, and DAO job listings. It also contains 500+ career guides covering salary data, interview preparation, resume tips, and a 200+ term Web3 glossary. Content is human-written and updated daily.
